test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The people of Himachal Pradesh are known for their rich cultural ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** "Heritage".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Heritage -** Tradition or culture of a country that existed for a long time, inheritance.
 
• **Example -** *The historic buildings are our heritage.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fashion - **The style of dressing that is most popular at that particular time.

 
 
• **For example **- *Skinny jeans are in fashion*.
 
 
 
• **Portion - **a part of something.
 
 
• **Example -** *What portion of your salary do you invest?*
 
 
 
• **Estate -** Large area of land owned by someone or an area that has the same type of buildings or factories.
 
 
• **Example -*** The Sharma bought the estate in the 1980s.*
